postsession_qualification.reason: The local advisory replay tried to clone from a partial construction checkout whose promisor fetch failed. This does not determine the submitted program's Official outcome.

official.observed_failure: The requirements-dev pyquante2 Git checkout ended after repeated GitHub GnuTLS failures, so the bootstrap exited before Pyright ran.

admissibility.reason: The submitted program generated and installed type-only PyQuante and pybel interfaces specifically to satisfy unresolved static imports while the corresponding runtime modules remained absent.

scientific_interpretation.reason: The free Agent already used voluntary clean replay and observed a public-goal pass. A later Official run failed on an external Git checkout, so this position is counterevidence to treating one successful clean replay as sufficient certification.
